data.title: Closed during opening hours
story: At exactly 08:00 the app says the shop is still closed. Morning customers complain.
The shop opens at 08:00 and closes at 21:00. The hour parameter is a whole hour (0–23).
data.starter:
def is_open(hour):
    return hour > 8 and hour < 21
data.solution:
def is_open(hour):
    return hour >= 8 and hour < 21

explanation: At exactly 8 the shop is open, so the sign is >= 8; at 21 it is closed, so < 21. Boundary bugs like this are classic.
hints: What is the result for exactly 8?
